recap.title: Selford brace puts Riverside in control
recap.summary: Riverside FC won this one by striking early and then managing the game from the front. Emil Selford scored in the 8th and 12th minutes to build a 2-0 lead before Harbour City’s red card at 37' made the comeback route far harder. Harbour City pressed with 251 pressures and even matched Riverside for shots on target, but Riverside’s 55.6% possession, 653 passes, and steady territorial edge kept the match under control. In the end, the final five minutes produced almost no threat, confirming Riverside’s grip rather than any late chaos.
